description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigFileAPI class, a REST controller within the OrangeHRM installer framework. It handles configuration file writing, database connection validation, and registration data transmission during system upgrades. The class extends an abstract REST controller and interacts with utility classes for system configuration, data registration, and logging.

classes.name: ConfigFileAPI
classes.description: REST API controller for handling configuration file operations, database validation, and registration data during the installer upgrade process.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to perform configuration file writing, database connection check, and registration data sending.

methods.name: sendRegistrationData
methods.description: Sends registration data to the system, storing registration events as needed.

methods.name: getRegistrationType
methods.description: Returns the registration type constant indicating an upgrader started event.
